Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: GIMACPAY is live in CEMAC including Central African Republic as part of regional rollout. Launched July 2020, supports instant P2P, P2B, cross-border etc. BEAC owns 99.2%. Partial deployment as regional system.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed. SIIPS 2023 and BEAC's own system page confirm GIMACPAY has been live since July 2020 across all six CEMAC states including CAR, with dozens of participants regionally (79-91 depending on the year). However, CAR's very low financial inclusion and internet coverage (~30% of the country, per World Bank/Carnegie reporting) mean practical reach within CAR is uneven, supporting 'Partially deployed' (4) rather than 'Fully deployed nationwide' (5).
